hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The evidence packet confirms all requirements are supported by the candidate's materials, with no unsupported claims or evidence gaps. The materials establish the candidate's role as technical lead since 2022, eight years of experience, secure development certification, incident review leadership, technical roadmap ownership, and mentoring. The materials do not establish prior experience as technical lead before 2022, but this is not required for the role as the candidate has been technical lead since 2022. The materials also do not specify the exact nature of the 'comparable transaction service' mentioned in the job description, but the candidate's role as technical lead of the card authorisation service is directly stated.
limitations: The materials do not establish the candidate's prior experience as technical lead of a real-time payments service before 2022, though the role since 2022 is confirmed.
The materials do not specify the exact details of the incident review process or the design review boundaries beyond what is stated in the sources.
The materials do not confirm whether the card authorisation service is a 'real-time payments service' as required by the job description, though it is described as a card authorisation service.
